metadata.short_desc: Request a song in chat and get the whole Bilibili track as a voice message
metadata.desc:
Request songs from the hajihami.com Bilibili play-count chart and receive the audio as a voice message in chat.

· /哈基米 - pick a random track from the pools you selected (top chart plus style tags, evenly split)
· /哈基米 <keyword> - fuzzy search, up to 5 results, reply with an index to play
· /哈基米 帮助 - usage help
· /哈基米状态 - runtime status (administrators only)

Audio is pulled from Bilibili and transcoded to a compact mp3. No login required; configuring a Cookie with a premium membership unlocks Hi-Res tracks.
